author: Stefanie Wind
body: This course has been extremely helpful for our baby’s sleep! We bought the baby package and love how it includes multiple options and grows with our baby. We had purchased another course and corresponding consultation with a different sleep consultant, but Baby Sleep Answers was more helpful AND less expensive. Our baby still has some hiccups with his sleep but I have always been able to refer to the course pdf and find helpful tips--it’s like Andrea knows our baby and what he’s about to do! I have already recommended this course to my friends who are expecting and I hope they buy it sooner than I did. :) Thanks, Andrea and Joe!!!
